Unlike with the Converted Tower, here you will not only have to do the gesture, but also wear a glintstone crown headpiece while doing so.

description: Sorcery of the servants of Death. Summons a group of Those Lost in Death. Three skeletons will appear some distance from the caster and attack foes before disappearing. The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.
effect: Summons Those Who Live in Death
obtain:
Altus Plateau,(Wyndham Ruins)
Drop: From the Tibia Mariner miniboss rowing through the waters.
ru:Зов Тибии
lore: Sorcery of the servants of Death.
Summons a group of Those Lost in Death. Three skeletons will appear some distance from the caster and attack foes before disappearing.
The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.

name: Blades of Stone
obtain:
Defeat Commander Gaius and trade his Remembrance with Finger Reader Enia.
Category:Sorceries
lore: Gravity-manipulating sorcery of Commander Gaius.
Pulls blade-like clumps of rock from the earth. Charging increases potency.
Gaius and Radahn were good rivals in their youth, and this sorcery is a product of their friendly competition.

name: Cherishing Fingers
description: A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, aspiring mother of fingers. Surrounds the caster with a mesh of hefty fingers that wards all manner of projectiles, whether magical or physical in nature, away from the caster. Charging enhances potency. The dear fingers look after their mother, or perhaps that is merely what the mother wishes to believe.
obtain:
Loot: Scadu Altus
Found in the small graveyard attached to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr after completing Count Ymir's questline.
effect: Surrounds the caster with a mesh of hefty fingers
lore: A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, aspiring mother of fingers.
Surrounds the caster with a mesh of hefty fingers that wards all manner of projectiles, whether magical or physical in nature, away from the caster. Charging enhances potency.
The dear fingers look after their mother, or perhaps that is merely what the mother wishes to believe.

name: Fleeting Microcosm
description: A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the secret hallowed rites. Conjures an image of a microcosm at a foe's feet that pulses with a single wave before disappearing in a burst. Charging enhances potency. The broken and discarded are fully willing to cling to fleeting simulacra, earning them some modicum of sympathy.
obtain:
Purchased: Cathedral of Manus Metyr
Fleeting Microcosm may be purchased from Count Ymir for  20,000 Runes after ringing the bell at the Finger Ruins of Dheo. He sits on the throne in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr on the Scadu Altus, located in the Realm of Shadow.
effect: Conjures a microcosm that pulses with a single wave, disappearing in a burst
lore: A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the secret hallowed rites.
Conjures an image of a microcosm at a foe's feet that pulses with a single wave before disappearing in a burst. Charging enhances potency.
The broken and discarded are fully willing to cling to fleeting simulacra, earning them some modicum of sympathy.
loreNotes: Fleeting Microcosm is a recreation of the microcosm held between the tail fingers of Metyr and the Staff of the Great Beyond. Metyr's microcosm once relayed information from the Greater Will.

name: Glintblade Trio
obtain:
Category:Sorceries
Category:Sorceries-Shadow of the Erdtree
effect: Creates sigil that forms three projectile glintblades after delay
lore: An old sorcery of the Carian royal family.
Creates a sigil overhead, from which three enemy-seeking glintblades appear after a brief delay. This sorcery can be used while in motion. Charging increases the delay.
The prototypical form of sword-phalanx sorceries saw a different subsequent refinement in the realm of shadow.

name: Glintstone Nail
description: Glintstone sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the finger sorceries said to have been discovered in a hallowed ruin. Flings a magic nail that crumbles during flight. Charging increases potency. Count Ymir boasts that this is mere child's play, an echo of a greater truth.
obtain:
Purchased: Cathedral of Manus Metyr
Glintstone Nail may be purchased from Count Ymir for  12,000 Runes after ringing the bell in the Finger Ruins of Rhia.
effect: Fires a shattering magic nail
lore: Glintstone sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the finger sorceries said to have been discovered in a hallowed ruin.
Flings a magic nail that crumbles during flight. Charging increases potency.
Count Ymir boasts that this is mere child's play, an echo of a greater truth.
loreNotes: This spell is used by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers.

The Catacombs Sorcerers cast an unobtainable variant of this spell as a Death Sorcery. It fires a projectile in a straight line that periodically splits into glintstone nails. The main projectile can also ricochet.
Update 1.13 increased the damage and improved the tracking of this spell.

name: Glintstone Nails
description: Glintstone sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the finger sorceries said to have been discovered in a hallowed ruin. Flings multiple magic nails that crumble during flight. Charging increases potency. Count Ymir boasts that this is mere child's play, an echo of a greater truth.
obtain:
Purchased: Cathedral of Manus Metyr
Glintstone Nails may be purchased from Count Ymir for  12,000 Runes after ringing the bell in the Finger Ruins of Rhia.
effect: Fires multiple shattering magic nails
lore: Glintstone sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest. One of the finger sorceries said to have been discovered in a hallowed ruin.
Flings multiple magic nails that crumble during flight. Charging increases potency.
Count Ymir boasts that this is mere child's play, an echo of a greater truth.
loreNotes: This spell is used by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers.
The Catacombs Sorcerers cast an unobtainable variant of this spell as a Death Sorcery.
Update 1.13 increased attack power by approximately 6% and improved enemy tracking.

name: Gravitational Missile
description: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Fires a gravitational projectile that pulls in enemies before finally exploding. Charging increases potency. Said to have originated in the lightless dark far beyond—the home of the fallingstar beasts.
obtain: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast found in the crater north of the Finger Ruins of Dheo.
effect: Fires a bolt of gravity that pulls in enemies
lore: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces.
Fires a gravitational projectile that pulls in enemies before finally exploding. Charging increases potency.
Said to have originated in the lightless dark far beyond—the home of the fallingstar beasts.

name: Impenetrable Thorns (Sorcery)
description: Sorcery of those who abandoned the practice of incantations after devout faith rewarded them with only despair. Summons the Scadutree's impenetrable thorns from the ground. This sorcery can be used repeatedly. The image of the twisted Scadutree is an edict: Denounce their ways. Do them harm. For they have abandoned us.
obtain:
Loot: Scadu Altus
Impenetrable Thorns is found in the Shadow Keep. Before ascending the stairs to the bridge leading to Messmer's tower, drop down to a balcony with a single Man-Bat. The sorcery is located on a corpse against the wall.
effect: Summons the Scadutree's impenetrable thorns from the earth
lore: Sorcery of those who abandoned the practice of incantations after devout faith rewarded them with only despair.
Summons the Scadutree's impenetrable thorns from the ground. This sorcery can be used repeatedly.

The image of the twisted Scadutree is an edict:
Denounce their ways. Do them harm.
For they have abandoned us.
loreNotes: Impenetrable Thorns is one of the spells used by the Scadutree Avatar at the Scadutree Base.
Update 1.13 decreased the effectiveness of this spell but improved its ability to track targets.

name: Mantle of Thorns
description: Sorcery of those who abandoned the practice of incantations after devout faith rewarded them with only despair. Covers the caster in impenetrable thorns grown from the Scadutree. Once covered, dodge rolls will damage enemies. The image of the misshapen Scadutree is an edict: Spurn all that exists. Wound all that exists. For we have been abandoned.
obtain:
Guaranteed Drop: Shadow Keep
After draining the water from the Shadow Keep Church District, defeat the Ulcerated Tree Spirit beside a large dead tree.
effect: Covers self with the Scadutree's impenetrable thorns
lore: Sorcery of those who abandoned the practice of incantations after devout faith rewarded them with only despair.
Covers the caster in impenetrable thorns grown from the Scadutree. Once covered, dodge rolls will damage enemies.

The image of the misshapen Scadutree is an edict:
Spurn all that exists.
Wound all that exists.
For we have been abandoned.
loreNotes: This thorn sorcery is not boosted by Alberich's Bracers, Alberich's Pointed Hat, Alberich's Robe, and Staff of the Guilty.
This is the only thorn sorcery that does not deal Magic damage.

name: Mass of Putrescence
obtain:
Found in the Stone Coffin Fissure by jumping to a lower ledge near the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace.
Category:Sorceries
Category:Sorceries-Shadow of the Erdtree
effect: Flings a great mass of putrescence
lore: Sorcery originating from the putrid liquor of the stone coffins.
Flings a great mass of putrescence that explodes shortly after impact, raining ghostflame upon the area.
In an age long past, Death was burned by ghostflame. Even the remains of tainted flesh were given equal treatment in death.

name: Miriam's Vanishing
obtain:
Available for purchase from Count Ymir upon first meeting him in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.
Category:Sorceries
Category:Sorceries-Shadow of the Erdtree
effect: Conceals self in a glintstone haze
lore: Sorcery of a preceptor who served the Carian royal family.
Used to conceal oneself in a glintstone haze, reappearing after a few seconds have passed. Directional inputs determine where one will reappear.
The curator of the study hall was such a master of this sorcery that it now bears her name.

name: Rellana's Twin Moons
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight, gained by defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, with Finger Reader Enia.
Alternatively, use one of the Remembrance Duplication Coffins to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
Category:Sorceries
Category:Sorceries-Shadow of the Erdtree
effect: Incarnate twin moons and repeatedly strike the ground
lore: Sorcery of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight. Associated with a Carian princess.
Incarnate overlapping twin moons which strike the ground one after the other, violently shaking the earth with moonlight.
In her childhood, she and her elder sister Rennala met these moons. Overlapping, as though nestled against one another.

name: Rings of Spectral Light
obtain:
Found in Charo's Hidden Grave on top of the arch leading from the Site of Grace to the Death Rite Bird. Go east from the Site of Grace to find the path up. The sorcery lies on an altar surrounded by Gravebirds.
Category:Sorceries
Category:Sorceries-Shadow of the Erdtree
effect: Creates rings of spectral light that fire in unison
lore: Sorcery practiced by the keepers of the spiritgraves, where all death ultimately drifts.
Creates rings of spectral light that fire in unison. Charging enhances potency.
The rings of light have the same qualities as ghostflame, and deal magic damage while also causing frost buildup.

name: Vortex of Putrescence
obtain:
Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia.
Category:Sorceries
Category:Sorceries-Shadow of the Erdtree
effect: Launches a whirl of putrescent jets
lore: Sorcery used by the Putrescent Knight.
Launches a whirl of putrescent jets that explode shortly after impact and bathe the area in ghostflame.
In an age long past, Death was burned by ghostflame. Even the remains of tainted flesh were given equal treatment in death.
